subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr fired a precise arrow into the mist from the edge of the corridor, efficiently targeting the enemy and demonstrating rare tactical discipline.
source_quote: Zephyr put an arrow into the mist from the edge of the corridor — precise, efficient, for once doing the sensible thing from distance.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia delivered a finishing blow on the second bugbear with a satisfying weight, contributing decisively to the collapse of the barricade.
source_quote: Sequoia's finishing blow on the second had a certain satisfying weight to it.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer unleashed a single pulse of guiding radiance that dissolved the double doors of the barricade, triggering the collapse of the enemy line and fulfilling the tactical objective.
source_quote: A single pulse of guiding radiance, the kind of divine light that doesn't ask permission, and the double doors at the barricade simply *stopped existing as an obstacle*.

subject: The Wraith
fact: The Wraith resisted Calmer's holy light, which dissolved into the cold air without effect, demonstrating unnatural resilience to divine power.
source_quote: The wraith looked at it. And did not flinch. The holy light dissolved into the cold air like breath in winter, leaving exactly nothing behind.

subject: Bugbears
fact: Bugbears held a fortified barricade of pews and rubble against the Earth Temple advance, maintaining a choke point until the barricade was destroyed.
source_quote: Bugbears behind an improvised barricade of pews and rubble, holding the stairway against an Earth Temple advance that had stalled somewhere in the haze ahead of us.

subject: Cultists
fact: Cultists formed the front line of the Fire Temple defense, positioned at the choke point and swiftly neutralized by direct assault.
source_quote: The cultist at the front of their line didn't see me coming... The cultist dropped before the bugbears had finished processing that we were there.

subject: Earth Temple
fact: The Earth Temple launched a stalled advance that was reinvigorated after the barricade was destroyed, flooding through the gap with tidal force.
source_quote: The Earth Temple forces came through the gap like the tide deciding to try something different.

subject: Fire Temple
fact: The Fire Temple maintained a defensive line that fractured into chaos after the barricade collapsed, exactly as the attackers had engineered.
source_quote: The Fire Temple line fractured into the exact kind of chaotic mess that we had specifically engineered this situation to produce.

subject: Air Temple Passage
fact: The Air Temple passage became the site of a confrontation with a wraith, marked by unnatural stillness and the failure of holy light.
source_quote: I came around the bend into the Air Temple passage and there it was, drifting in the dark ahead of us.

subject: Corridor (Scalding Battlefield)
fact: The corridor was transformed into a steam-choked battlefield, littered with bodies and fortified by barricades, where tactical engagements unfolded in poor visibility.
source_quote: A corridor that had turned itself into something between a battle and a sauna... Stone floor. Bodies in Earth Temple brown and Fire Temple red...

subject: Barricade (pews and rubble)
fact: The barricade, constructed from pews and rubble, served as a choke point that held the advance until it was destroyed by divine intervention.
source_quote: Bugbears behind an improvised barricade of pews and rubble...

subject: Barricade Destruction
fact: The barricade was destroyed by Calmer’s divine radiance, triggering the collapse of the Fire Temple’s defensive line and enabling the Earth Temple advance.
source_quote: The double doors at the barricade simply *stopped existing as an obstacle*. They flew open with the kind of finality that makes everyone on both sides pause for half a breath.

subject: Cultist Neutralization
fact: A cultist at the front of the Fire Temple line was swiftly eliminated by direct assault, removing the hinge of the barricade and initiating the tactical collapse.
source_quote: Through the steam, into the billowing white heat, and then just — strikes, a sequence of controlled impacts... The cultist dropped before the bugbears had finished processing that we were there.

subject: Steam Phenomenon
fact: An unexplained, escalating steam phenomenon persists after the battle, feeding on elemental violence and threatening to become indiscriminate.
source_quote: The steam was still there, and it was getting worse. Elemental violence has a way of feeding itself...

subject: Wraith Resilience
fact: The wraith’s immunity to holy light suggests an entity beyond conventional undead, raising questions about its origin and nature.
source_quote: The holy light dissolved into the cold air like breath in winter, leaving exactly nothing behind.

subject: mission completion
fact: The mission was accomplished in the narrowest operational sense: barricade broken, advance resumed, factions engaged in mutual destruction.
source_quote: The mission was accomplished in the narrowest operational sense: the barricade broken, the advance resumed, the fire and earth factions in the process of tearing into each other exactly as intended.

subject: disengagement
fact: The team initiated disengagement immediately after mission success, recognizing the kill zone had become indiscriminate.
source_quote: Time to not be here anymore... You're exiting the kill zone you personally created before it becomes indiscriminate about its victims.
